title: Owner decides whether Live stops showing "No BPM set" on every cue
acceptance: The owner decides: keep Live's per-cue "No BPM set", or show it in a quieter, neutral tone. Design system 10 §1a requires missing tempo in Live as supporting status under an affirmative ready state, so dropping it entirely would need a canon change (which iOS follows) and is not offered as a plain option. The answer is recorded here; any implementation gets its own record.
